STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_08990_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_08990_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_08990 (
    input ddr_rstn_i,                
    input clk,

    output ddr_rstn,                
    output ddr_cfg_seq_rst,            
    output reg ddr_cfg_seq_start,    

    output reg ddr_init_done        
);

parameter FREQ = 100;

localparam CNT_INIT = 1.5*FREQ*1000;

reg [1:0] rstn_dly;
always @(posedge clk or negedge ddr_rstn_i) begin
    if (!ddr_rstn_i) begin
        rstn_dly <= 2'd0;
    end else begin
        rstn_dly[0] <= 1'b1;
        rstn_dly[1] <= rstn_dly[0];
    end
end

assign ddr_rstn = ddr_rstn_i;
assign ddr_cfg_seq_rst = ~rstn_dly[1];

reg [19:0] cnt;
reg [1:0] cnt_start;

always @(posedge clk or negedge ddr_rstn_i) begin
    if (!ddr_rstn_i) begin
        ddr_init_done <= 1'b0;
        cnt <= CNT_INIT;
    end else begin
        if (cnt != 20'd0) begin
            cnt <= cnt - 20'd1;
        end else begin
            cnt <= cnt;
            ddr_init_done <= 1'b1;
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge clk or negedge rstn_dly[1]) begin
    if (!rstn_dly[1]) begin
        ddr_cfg_seq_start <= 1'b0;
        cnt_start <= 2'd0;
    end else begin
        if (cnt_start == 2'b11) begin
            ddr_cfg_seq_start <= 1'b1;
            cnt_start <= cnt_start;
        end else begin
            cnt_start <= cnt_start + 1'b1;
        end
    end
end

endmodule
